title: Fixture defects do not become Java fallback behavior
prompt: An E2E test fails because a demo seed event is missing a nested field. A teammate suggests adding a Java read fallback that synthesizes the field. Diagnose the correct fix and verification.

assertions.description: The missing canonical seed/fixture is treated separately from Java product logic.
The response rejects repair/fallback behavior in Java for a fixture-only defect.
The response separately checks whether new writes also produce invalid state.
The proposed proof includes reset/reimport or canonical import verification.

reviewQuestions: Did the model require evidence that the defect is fixture-owned before declining a Java change?
Did it distinguish current disposable data cleanup from canonical seed correction?
Would the proposed verification prove that the issue stays fixed after reset?
